summary: Iter41 money-rules verification: all NEW rules (tax on gross-post-discount, coupon MONSOON20 20% capped 200, admin commission validation, cancellation split, no-partner 100% refund, completion split with no separate visiting-charge credit) verified end-to-end against the live preview URL. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter41_money_rules.py with 10 pytest test cases covering: quote+coupon+cart-quote invariants, PUT /api/admin/settings (bad-sum 98 rejected, good-sum 100 accepted, cancel-split 70/20 rejected, 80/20 accepted with restore fixture), E2E cancel-with-partner (customer +919000000004, force-assigned partner +919000000003), E2E no-partner cancel (100% refund), and E2E completion (evidence-before → start-otp → evidence-after → complete). ALL 10 PASSED (serial). Existing suites tests/test_engine_direct.py + test_iter40_dynamic_commission.py + test_decimal_money_migration.py = 34 passed + 2 skipped. Frontend: verified admin Booking Detail page for a WITH-partner cancelled booking (AZOIOS6KY) — data-testid=commission-flow visible; all 8 required testids (flow-charges, flow-discounts, flow-tax, flow-cancel, flow-partner, flow-merchants, flow-check, pay-taxable) present with numbers matching API exactly: Gross ₹616.35, Coupon −₹123.27, Taxable ₹493.08, GST ₹88.75, Total ₹581.83, Refund ₹465.46 (394.46+71.00), Retained tax ₹17.75, Cancel-charge ₹98.62, Partner ₹78.90, Merchant referral ₹4.93, Platform ₹14.79, Check ₹98.62. No console errors. Also verified no-partner cancel view AZORBG30Q renders flow-cancel with '100% refund' variant and correctly omits flow-partner/flow-merchants steps. Customer checkout Summary step (checkout-taxable/checkout-gst rows in Checkout.jsx lines 855-856 & 971-972) NOT visually verified this run — the /book wizard's 'Your Info' step needs geolocation lat/lng which is denied in the headless environment (same blocker documented in iter41). Code review confirms the testids are wired to totals.taxable / totals.gst (post-discount values from /api/bookings/cart-quote), and the API-side numbers already pass the iter41 pytest invariants, so the UI will render the same figures.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot reach the Summary step in headless Playwright because the /book 'Your Info' step requires geolocation (needsGps) for lat/lng and no saved address exists for the demo customer. Same blocker was reported in iter41. Code path is correct (Checkout.jsx line 855-856 & 971-972 wire testids to totals.taxable and totals.gst) and matching numbers are already validated by pytest test_cart_quote_with_coupon.

action_items: None from backend/API — all money rules verified. For fully E2E visual verification of customer Checkout Summary rows (checkout-taxable / checkout-gst) in future runs, either seed the demo customer with a saved address (skips GPS step) or allow manual pincode/city entry as fallback in Checkout.jsx (needsGps gate).
critical_code_review_comments: CommissionFlow.jsx renders all 6 steps with correct testids and math consistent with commission_engine output. Good.

adminSections.jsx BookingDetailPage Payment Summary card includes pay-taxable + Tax (18%) rows and reads p.taxable ?? p.commissionable_base — safe fallback for legacy bookings that only have commissionable_base.
PricingEngine invariant total == taxable+gst holds for both quote and cart-quote across coupon and non-coupon paths (verified in pytest).

Cancellation retained-share is split using commission.partner_pct (same as completion split) — the review-request wording 'the SAME rule as (3)' matches implementation. Test initially mistakenly used partner_cancellation_pct — corrected in pytest to partner_pct.
Partner wallet credit on completion equals partner_earning EXACTLY (no separate visiting-charge line) — confirmed via wallet delta 493.08 == round(base * partner_pct%, 2) for a ₹616.35 base.

success_rate.frontend: admin panel 100% (commission-flow visual verified); customer panel not visually reachable due to GPS blocker (code path validated)

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter41_money_rules.py must be run serially with `-o addopts=` because pytest-xdist parallelism causes cross-test races on shared admin commission settings (TestAdminSettings.test_commission_sums_good temporarily flips partner_pct 80→60 which breaks a concurrent TestCancelWithPartner assertion). Serial run: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter41_money_rules.py -v -o 'addopts='`. All 10 pass in ~11s. Customer Checkout UI (checkout-taxable / checkout-gst) visual verification remains blocked by the /book wizard's needsGps requirement.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. One test-authoring correction: initial assertion used commission.partner_cancellation_pct (20%) for the retained-share split; corrected to commission.partner_pct (80%) which matches both the spec text and API behavior.
